title: Continuous-angle logical rotations in the Steane code
summary: We experimentally demonstrate continuous-angle logical $Z$ rotations in the $[[7,1,3]]$ Steane code on the IonQ Forte trapped-ion processor. A round of the protocol applies a transversal physical $Z$ rotation by $θ$, followed by Steane syndrome extraction and decoding, which induces a syndrome-dependent logical $Z$ rotation. We analytically derive the effect of dephasing noise on the logical rotation angle and logical dephasing rate.
